name: read_file
description: Inspect a local file or directory. File lines include one-based numbers and tabs. Read only unseen ranges unless an edit reports that the file changed; do not re-read merely to check freshness.

file_path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the working directory.

limit.description: Line count to read; defaults to 100. Unused for directories.

offset.description: Lines to skip; defaults to zero. Unused for directories.
